Introducing our 8mm Red Straw, the premium disposable drinking straw specifically designed for coffee shops, cafes, restaurants, bars, and events. This red drinking straw combines functionality, vibrant color, and durability in one perfect solution for serving beverages with eye-catching style and professional quality.

Our 8mm red disposable straw features a perfect 8mm diameter that’s ideal for a wide range of beverages including coffee, tea, juice, smoothies, cocktails, soft drinks, and more. The 8mm diameter is the ideal size for most beverages – not too narrow for thick drinks, not too wide for regular beverages. Perfect for coffee, tea, juice, cocktails, soft drinks, smoothies, and all types of drinks.

Disposable design ensures maximum hygiene standards – individually wrapped options available for premium service and health safety compliance.

📦 Bulk Availability
Available in various bulk quantities from small packs to wholesale orders – perfect for businesses of all sizes and requirements.

🎯 Versatile Applications
Beyond regular beverages – perfect for parties, events, catering, weddings, birthdays, Valentine’s Day, Christmas, and any festive occasion.

  • ✅ Wide clear front window — full product visibility drives impulse purchase

  • ✅ Resealable zipper closure — maintains freshness between multiple uses
  • ✅ Rounded bottom gusset — stable upright display on shelf and counter
  • ✅ Leak-resistant construction — prevents oil and brine seepage
  • ✅ BPA-free & food certified — safe for direct food contact

description:
🥤 Product Overview

The Plain Aluminum Standup Spout Pouch 1000ml (17x25cm) is a professional-grade liquid packaging solution — engineered for brands, manufacturers, and businesses that need reliable, leak-proof, lightweight, and cost-effective packaging for liquid products at the 1-litre scale.

💧 “One litre. Zero leaks. Total freshness. The aluminium spout pouch built for liquid professionals.”

This 17x25cm 1000ml format is the industry standard choice for liquid product packaging — perfectly sized for fruit juices, energy drinks, sauces, condiments, liquid detergents, shampoos, refill products, and industrial liquids that need a secure, portable, and shelf-stable packaging solution. The screw-cap spout provides precision pouring control and a reliable reseal after every use — eliminating the mess, spillage, and waste associated with traditional bottle and jar packaging.

The premium silver aluminium exterior is not just visually striking — it is a functional barrier powerhouse, blocking moisture, oxygen, UV light, and external contamination to keep every liquid product perfectly preserved from production to the moment of consumption or use. Combined with the wide flat gusseted base, the pouch stands firmly upright on any surface — making it equally at home on retail shelves, production lines, and consumer kitchen counters.

At 1000ml capacity, this is the most popular spout pouch size in our range — delivering the ideal balance between generous volume and practical everyday handling.

🌟 Key Highlights

Feature Detail
🔩 Screw Cap Spout Leak-proof precision pour & reliable reseal
🛡️ Aluminium Barrier Blocks moisture, UV light & oxygen completely
📐 Size 17cm (W) × 25cm (H) — 1000ml / 1 Litre
💧 Leak-Proof Design Zero spillage — safe for liquids, sauces & beverages
🧱 Stand-Up Bottom Wide flat gusset — stable upright on any surface
🍃 Food-Safe & BPA-Free Safe for direct liquid food contact
♻️ Lightweight Significantly lighter than glass or rigid plastic bottles
🖨️ Printable Surface Custom branding & label ready
🌡️ Temperature Stable Suitable for hot fill, cold fill & ambient storage
💰 Cost Efficient Lower packaging cost per unit vs rigid containers

description:
🥤 Product Overview

The Plain Aluminum Standup Spout Pouch 300ml (11x18cm) is a compact professional-grade liquid packaging solution — engineered for brands, food producers, and businesses that need reliable, leak-proof, lightweight, and cost-effective small-format packaging for liquid products at the 300ml scale.

💧 “Compact. Precise. Leak-proof. The 300ml aluminium spout pouch built for small-format liquid perfection.”

This 11x18cm 300ml format is the ideal small-format choice for liquid product packaging — perfectly sized for single-serve fruit juices, baby food pouches, health shots, energy drinks, small sauce packs, condiment portions, personal care samples, and small liquid refills that need a secure, portable, and shelf-stable packaging solution in a compact and convenient size.

The screw-cap spout provides precision pouring control in a small format — delivering the same professional leak-proof performance as larger spout pouches but in a size that is perfectly suited for on-the-go consumption, portion control, and single-serve retail. The compact 300ml size is especially popular for baby food and toddler food pouches, where the easy-squeeze, easy-pour spout makes feeding clean, convenient, and mess-free.

The premium silver aluminium exterior delivers industrial-grade barrier protection — blocking moisture, oxygen, UV light, and external contamination to keep every liquid product perfectly preserved from production to the moment of use. The wide flat gusseted base ensures the pouch stands firmly upright on any surface — making it equally at home on retail shelves, lunch boxes, and kitchen counters.

🌟 Key Highlights

Feature Detail
🔩 Screw Cap Spout Compact leak-proof precision pour & reliable reseal
🛡️ Aluminium Barrier Blocks moisture, UV light & oxygen completely
📐 Size 11cm (W) × 18cm (H) — 300ml compact format
💧 Leak-Proof Design Zero spillage — safe for all liquid contents
🧱 Stand-Up Bottom Flat gusset — stable upright on any surface
🍃 Food-Safe & BPA-Free Safe for direct liquid food contact
👶 Baby Food Safe Ideal for baby food, toddler pouches & infant nutrition
♻️ Lightweight Significantly lighter than glass or rigid plastic
🖨️ Printable Surface Custom branding & label ready
💰 Cost Efficient Lower packaging cost per unit vs rigid containers

description:
Black Kraft Standup Pouch with Window – 14×20 cm (Medium Premium)

Introducing the Black Kraft Standup Pouch (14×20 cm) —
our most practical, most powerful, and most widely used
medium-format premium packaging solution. This is the size
that perfectly balances generous capacity with
commanding luxury presentation — large enough
to hold the most popular everyday premium food quantities,
yet perfectly proportioned to display with maximum
visual impact on any retail shelf, health store counter,
boutique display, or premium gift arrangement.

At 14 cm wide and 20 cm tall, the 14×20 cm
black kraft standup pouch occupies the most important
position in our black kraft range — the
everyday premium workhorse that serves
coffee brands, cookie companies, supplement businesses,
dry fruit specialists, protein powder brands, and
granola producers with equal power and elegance.
The deep matte black exterior transforms
every product it holds into a premium, exclusive,
and highly desirable offering — communicating
luxury, quality, and sophistication from
every angle.

The clear front window delivers a
dramatic visual contrast against the deep matte black
surface — creating an irresistible product showcase
that draws customers in, builds immediate trust,
and drives purchase decisions at the point of sale.
The resealable zip lock closure
maintains perfect freshness for 200–350g quantities
through repeated openings, while the
stand-up gusset base ensures
your black kraft pouch stands tall, stable,
and dominant on any retail surface.

With the widest printable front panel
in the medium black kraft range, the
14×20 cm pouch gives your brand the perfect
canvas for gold foil, silver foil,
or white ink custom printing —
creating the most luxurious branded packaging
available for medium-format food products
in Pakistan.

  • 🏪 Stand-up gusset base for premium retail shelf display

  • 🖨️ Gold, silver & white ink custom printing available

description:
White Kraft Standup Pouch with Window – 18×26 cm (Jumbo XXL)

Introducing the White Kraft Standup Pouch (18×26 cm) —
the absolute pinnacle of our white kraft standup pouch collection and
our largest, most powerful, and highest-capacity packaging
solution. This is not just a pouch — it is a
complete brand statement engineered for food businesses,
wholesale distributors, and export brands that refuse to compromise on
quality, capacity, or presentation.

At an imposing 18 cm wide and 26 cm tall, this Jumbo
XXL pouch commands attention on every shelf it occupies. The
full-width clear front window — the largest in our
entire range — creates an immersive product showcase that builds
immediate consumer trust and drives purchase decisions
at the point of sale. When your customer can see your product in its
full glory through a crystal-clear window, the product sells itself.

Designed for the most demanding packaging requirements, the 18×26 cm
pouch handles everything from bulk coffee and premium grain
blends to large-format protein powders, wholesale
dry fruit mixes, and high-volume spice collections. The
industrial-strength resealable zip lock maintains
product integrity, aroma, and moisture protection through hundreds
of openings — making it the trusted choice for products with
extended shelf life requirements.

The heavy-duty reinforced stand-up gusset base is
engineered to support the weight of high-density bulk fills, ensuring
your pouch stands tall, stable, and professional on any retail shelf,
warehouse display, or trade show surface. Combined with the
maximum branding surface of the 18 cm wide front
panel, this pouch gives your brand the largest canvas in our range
to tell its story, showcase its values, and connect with consumers.

  • 🌿 Premium eco-friendly white kraft exterior — sustainably sourced
  • 🔒 Industrial-strength resealable zip lock for maximum freshness
  • 👁️ Full-width transparent front window — largest in our range
  • 🏪 Heavy-duty reinforced stand-up gusset base for bulk fills
  • 🍽️ Industrial food-safe inner lining — FDA compliant
  • 💧 Complete moisture, aroma & humidity resistant barrier
  • 🖨️ Maximum branding surface — full-panel custom printing ready
  • ♻️ Fully recyclable and biodegradable kraft construction
  • 📦 Engineered for retail, wholesale, export & high-volume packaging
  • 🌍 Eco-conscious jumbo packaging for sustainable brands
  • ⚖️ Highest capacity — ideal for 500g to 800g product fills
  • 🌐 Export-ready — meets international food packaging standards
